title.narrative: PCB Management and Disposal at the Energy Sector

description.narrative: ..The project aims to facilitate the implementation of the Stockholm Convention on POPs in respect of sound management of PCBs and P CB-containing equipment and wastes including development of specific legislations, implementation of environmentally sound management practices, inventory, testing, labeling of at least 1000 electrical equipment and disposal/decontamination of 250 tones of PCB-containing equipment and wastes.
